places.name: Liège-Guillemins Train Station (Calatrava Design)
places.ai_summary: Liège-Guillemins Train Station is a modern architectural masterpiece designed by Santiago Calatrava. It serves as a major transport hub and a symbol of contemporary design in Liège.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight or evening illuminations.

places.place_tip: Capture photos of the station’s unique design, especially at sunset.

places.name: Montagne de Bueren (374 Steps View)
places.ai_summary: Montagne de Bueren is a historic staircase with 374 steps leading to a panoramic view of Liège. It is a challenging climb but offers rewarding vistas of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours for safety.

places.place_tip: Take breaks during the climb and enjoy the murals along the way.

places.name: Liège Cathedral (St. Paul’s)
places.ai_summary: Liège Cathedral, also known as St. Paul’s Cathedral, is a Romanesque-Gothic cathedral in Liège, Belgium. It is the principal church of the Diocese of Liège and a notable example of religious architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Respect the religious nature of the site; quiet contemplation is encouraged.
places.address: Place de la Cathédrale, 4000 Liège, Belgium

places.ai_summary: The Palace of the Prince-Bishops is a historic palace in Liège, Belgium, that served as the residence of the Prince-Bishops of Liège. It is an important example of civil Gothic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available; check schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the surrounding area for a complete experience.

places.ai_summary: The Curtius Museum is a museum in Liège, Belgium, dedicated to the history and archaeology of the Liège region. Housed in a beautiful mansion, it features a range of exhibits from prehistory to the modern era.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the archaeological garden and the stunning views from the museum.
